plan.purpose: One fresh-user vault, paused with zero payment funds; cancellation before signing and interruption/resume of the same create request
plan.key_selection: Only a currently on-chain listed FullAccess key proven by a fresh Meteor login; no key export or new key installation

funding_policy.change_from_default_plan: Remove only the discretionary 0.5 NEAR factory reserve; retain the existing storage allowance and tested contract artifacts

fee_calculation.rule: send gas * block price + receipt gas * max(block price, min purchase price); Ed25519 verification surcharge zero; no delegate actions
fee_calculation.notice: Upfront allowance, not final expenditure. Do not add account-creation charge again. Execution/price refunds require final receipts.

funding_summary.topup_source: Unselected; no faucet or funding transaction authorized by this plan

execution_conditions: Explicit approval of this plan digest; no signing or broadcast while approval is absent
Funding received; fresh finalized testnet/protocol/key/balance/target checks and fresh wallet-control proof
Storage byte price unchanged; block gas price <= 100000000; minimum gas purchase price <= 1000000000; fee schedule unchanged; otherwise reprice and obtain revised approval
Infrastructure transaction FINAL before customer call; verify exact pinned factory code, embedded vault hash, immutable configuration and no keys
Record exact unsigned transaction bytes/hash/nonce before wallet request; unknown outcome must reconcile before any retry
Customer call only through reviewed Create vault flow; transaction hash must remain the same across interruption/resume
Link only after FINAL success, complete receipt checks and finalized expected vault code/no keys/owner/state
Do not deliberately cause on-chain failure or broadcast an additional duplicate transaction under this approval
unresolved: Checkpoint bootstrap trust unresolved; payment controls disabled
Factory callback/refund failure has no automatic recovery; unknown outcomes remain blocked
Reduced factory reserve is source-derived, not a separately VM-measured minimum-storage boundary
Deployment transport and real Meteor key must be confirmed before signing
